sticky.link_hint: Ctrl+click: open folder, URL or email in the default app
sticky.open_failed: Could not open the destination in the default app.
sticky.title: STICKY NOTE
sticky.attachment_removed: Attachment removed from the note. The original file was kept.
sticky.email_invalid: Enter a valid email address and a subject without line breaks.
sticky.email_locked: The note was locked. Unlock it again before opening the draft.
sticky.email_failed: Could not open the email draft: {error}
sticky.local_files_only: Choose or drop local files to attach them.
sticky.drop_select_file: The file manager did not grant access to the dropped file. Select it in the window that opens.
sticky.attach_secret_unlocked: Unlock the secret note before adding attachments.
domain.sticky_storage.invalid_database: Invalid notes database. The files were preserved.
domain.sticky_storage.invalid_legacy_not: Invalid legacy note. The original was preserved.
domain.sticky_storage.concurrent_edit: The note was changed by another process. Copy the text before reloading.
domain.sticky_storage.backup_purge_faile: The note could not be removed from backups. It remains active; retry after checking storage access.
sticky.pin_forgot_warning: This permanently deletes every secret note, its attachment metadata, and associated Orbitz temporary email drafts. Regular notes are kept. Original files and copies already opened or saved in other applications are not removed. Physical erasure on SSDs and external backups cannot be guaranteed. This action cannot be undone.
sticky.pin_forgot_confirm: Delete secret notes and reset PIN
sticky.pin_reset_complete: Secret notes deleted. Set a new PIN.
sticky.pin_reset_cache_warning: Secret notes and the PIN were removed, but some temporary drafts could not be cleared: {error}
sticky.pin_reset_storage_warning: Secret notes and the PIN were removed, but SQLite did not confirm full cleanup of its temporary journal. Restart the app and check storage.
sticky.email_cache_cleanup_failed: The note was deleted, but some temporary drafts could not be cleared: {error}
sticky.pin_format: Use exactly 4 digits from 0 to 9 and confirm the same PIN.
sticky.pin_limitation: The PIN only locks the interface. Text and titles remain unencrypted in SQLite and backups. It does not protect files from direct access.
sticky.secret_save_failed: Note locked. Changes could not be saved; they remain in this session.
domain.sticky_storage.pin_format: The PIN must contain exactly 4 digits from 0 to 9.
domain.sticky_storage.pin_metadata_inval: The PIN configuration is invalid. The data was preserved.
domain.sticky_storage.pin_already_set: A PIN is already configured. Enter the current PIN to change it.
domain.sticky_storage.pin_not_set: Set up a PIN before protecting a note.
domain.sticky_storage.pin_locked: Too many attempts. Wait before trying again.
domain.sticky_storage.attachment_invalid: Choose a regular file, not a symbolic link.
domain.sticky_storage.attachment_too_lar: Each attachment can be at most 50 MiB.
domain.sticky_storage.attachment_type: This file type is not supported.
domain.sticky_storage.attachment_count: A note can have up to 10 attachments.
domain.sticky_storage.attachment_total_s: Attachments for a note can total up to 100 MiB.
domain.sticky_storage.attachment_duplica: This file is already attached to the note.
sticky.pin_retry: Too many attempts. Wait {seconds}s before trying again.
